description: This file implements a client for managing a Document Processing AI (DocsPi) process, including starting the process, communicating via prompts, handling responses, and parsing JSON payloads. It includes definitions for client structure, event handling, and utility functions for process control and message extraction.

classes.name: docsPiClient
classes.description: A client managing an external DocsPi AI process, handling process control, message exchange, and event management.

classes.name: docsPiClientOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for initializing a DocsPi client, including system prompt and thinking prompt strings.

classes.name: piEvent
classes.description: Represents events emitted by the DocsPi process, such as responses or agent end signals.

classes.name: agentEndPayload
classes.description: Payload structure for an agent end message, containing message history and type.

classes.name: rpcResponse
classes.description: Response structure for RPC calls made to the DocsPi process.

classes.name: agentMessage
classes.description: Represents individual messages exchanged between the agent and the process, including role, content, and status.

classes.name: contentBlock
classes.description: Content block structure used to parse message content, especially for text type blocks.

methods.name: startDocsPiClient
methods.description: Initializes and starts the DocsPi process, returning a client instance for communication.

methods.name: Prompt
methods.description: Sends a prompt message to the DocsPi process and waits for a response or error.

methods.name: Stderr
methods.description: Returns the accumulated standard error output from the process.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the client and the underlying process.

methods.name: captureStderr
methods.description: Reads and buffers the standard error output from the process asynchronously.

methods.name: readStdout
methods.description: Reads and processes stdout lines from the process, dispatching events based on message type.

methods.name: extractTranslationResult
methods.description: Extracts the textual result from an agent end payload, handling errors and message parsing.

methods.name: extractContentText
methods.description: Extracts human-readable text from JSON message content, supporting plain text and block formats.

methods.name: decodeRpcResponse
methods.description: Decodes a JSON raw message into an RPC response structure.

methods.name: getDocsPiAgentDir
methods.description: Determines and ensures the directory path used for the DocsPi agent files.
